title: OpenAI to double workforce as business push intensifies

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might doubling OpenAI’s workforce mean for the pace of AI innovation—and the risks that come with it?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models like GPT-5 require massive compute. Scaling teams helps iterate faster, but hardware bottlenecks still limit deployment speed.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: More engineers could accelerate dangerous applications—like deepfakes or autonomous weapons—before safeguards are in place.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are prioritizing alignment research and red-team testing to catch risks early in the development pipeline.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI is both a tool for global problem-solving and governed by transparent, inclusive standards is within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The next decade will test whether growth in AI power can be matched by growth in wisdom and responsibility.
